maria_peopleops: Quick question — traveling to Berlin next week. Can I expense the Schengen visa fee and a one-time seat upgrade to exit row if it reduces jetlag for a client meeting?

sam_finance: Short answer: visa fee = reimbursable with receipt. Seat upgrades are allowed only when medically necessary or client-required; personal comfort upgrades are usually not covered.

maria_peopleops: Got it. What counts as proof for the visa fee? PDF of the consulate payment screen?

sam_finance: Yes — itemized receipt or confirmation email showing amount, payer name, and payment method. If the consulate only gives a reference number, take a screenshot of the payment confirmation + bank debit line.

mike_engineering: @sam_finance what about upgrades booked by the traveler because the company card wasn't available? I charged the extra seat on my personal card, any pre-approval needed retroactively?

sam_finance: If > $75 or an upgrade, we need manager pre-approval. Retro approvals can be made but attach manager note in the expense. Otherwise it may be denied.

jordan_manager: @mike_engineering I approved the upgrade after you pinged me in DM. @sam_finance marking here for the retro-ok.

travel-bot: Reminder: submit travel expense within 30 days. Use the Travel Request form for pre-approvals: https://intranet.redwood/travel-request :calendar:

maria_peopleops: Does per diem apply for this trip or do we require actual meal receipts?

sam_finance: EU day trips => meals by receipt. Overnight stays outside your home country => per diem option available. If you pick per diem, do NOT submit meal receipts separately for the same day.

maria_peopleops: What's the per diem rate for Germany?

sam_finance: Current per diem: Germany = 54 EUR/day (meals & incidental). If trip < 24h but includes an overnight, prorate by hours.

mike_engineering: Ok. Currency conversion? I paid in EUR on personal card.

sam_finance: Use the date-of-transaction rate from the corporate FX tool (link in the expense template). If you used your bank rate, include the card statement. We will normalize to company rate.

maria_peopleops: Any special handling for VAT on hotels?

sam_finance: Hotels: we reclaim VAT when invoices show VAT line and company address. Attach folio with nightly rates and VAT breakouts. If the hotel only issues a credit card receipt without VAT, flag it and we can try to recover via our VAT agent for business travel.

mike_engineering: Example of itemized expense lines for me to paste:```
Flight FRA-SFO: 420.00 EUR (company card)
Schengen visa fee: 80.00 EUR (personal card)
Hotel folio (3 nights): 450.00 EUR incl VAT
Meal per diem: 54.00 EUR/day instead of receipts
Seat upgrade (exit row): 35.00 EUR (personal card) - manager approved 2026-03-15
```

sam_finance: Perfect format. Make sure each line has a receipt attached. For personal-card items include last 4 of card and statement proof.

maria_peopleops: One edge case — client bought my ticket and sent invoice to their AP. Can Redwood reimburse client invoice or do I need to route differently?

sam_finance: We can reimburse a third party vendor if we have an invoice showing your name as traveler and client AP details. Finance will need a copy of the client's invoice and confirmation that the client expects reimbursement to them. We prefer company-paid bookings so this is case-by-case.

travel-bot: Travel policy updates v3.2 posted: https://intranet.redwood/policies/travel-v3.2. Notable: pre-approval required for any upgrade > $50, receipts required for expenses > $25, per diem country list updated.

maria_peopleops: Thanks all — I'll submit via the expense tool today and attach the visa receipt + manager note. :slightly_smiling_face:
